name: treka
description: Work with your Treka tour and guiding business: bookings, departures, revenue and guide pay.

interface.longDescription:
Treka is booking and operations software for outdoor guides, tour operators and outfitters. Connect your Treka account to ChatGPT to work with your business in plain language.

Ask about your business:
- Company overview: trips, upcoming departures, recent bookings and revenue
- Trips and departures, with capacity, seats booked and seats left
- Bookings, searchable by date, trip, status or guest, including guest contact details
- Revenue by month or by trip, counted the way the Treka dashboard counts it
- Guide invoices, reviews and gift cards

Get tasks done, only if you turn on "Allow changes" when you connect:
- Add departures, change seats, mark a date sold out or reopen it
- Add a manual booking or hold, update guest details or party size, add a private note, confirm a booking, or cancel an unpaid one
- Email a booking's guest from your company
- Edit trip details such as title, description and price
- Approve or reject guide invoices

How it stays safe:
- You sign in to Treka and choose the company. Only owners and admins can connect.
- Read-only by default. Changes need your permission, and ChatGPT asks before each one.
- Payments, refunds and payouts are never made through ChatGPT; they stay in the Treka portal.
- Every change is recorded in Treka, and you can disconnect at any time from Connections.

Requires a Treka account.
